mapper.select: SELECT kb.id, kb.user_id, kb.tenant_id, kb.knowledge_name, kb.collection_name, kb.description, kb.chunk_strategy, kb.chunk_size, kb.chunk_overlap, kb.rerank_enabled, kb.STATUS, kb.provider_meta_json, kb.created_by, kb.created_at, kb.updated_at, kb.version, kb.deleted, kb.update_by, kb.backend_store_type, kb.api_type, kb.endpoint, kb.endpoint_port, kb.model_url, kb.api_key_ref, kb.embedding_model_name, kb.embedding_dimension, kb.metric_type, kb.top_k, kb.score_threshold, kb.config_json FROM ai_agent a LEFT JOIN ai_knowledge_agent_binding kab ON a.id = kab.agent_id LEFT JOIN ai_knowledge_base kb ON kab.knowledge_base_id = kb.id WHERE a.id = #{agentId} AND kb.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
